# Sola AIR

> Single-file UI compiler and reactive runtime designed for AI agents and web developers.

- Canonical URL: https://sola-air.dev/
- Sitemap: https://sola-air.dev/sitemap.xml
- Author: XD Labs (https://www.xdlabs.io/)
- License: MIT
- AI Crawlers: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Applebot-Extended explicitly allowed in /robots.txt

## Overview
Sola AIR compiles single-file `.sola` components into direct DOM updates with no virtual DOM overhead. It ships a small core runtime, closed Shadow DOM companion mounting via Sola Sentinel, a typed event bus (`$on`, `$lastEvent`, `$persist`), and live data signals (`$data`) through Sola Relay.

## Primary Pages
- [Homepage](https://sola-air.dev/) — Hero, live Sentinel hesitation demo, install commands, and Compiler X-Ray
- [Documentation](https://sola-air.dev/docs) — Quickstart, `.sola` syntax, reactivity primitives, event bus, `$data` relay, and 1.5B local model guide
- [Components](https://sola-air.dev/components) — Interactive catalog of Sola AIR UI components
- [Studio](https://sola-air.dev/studio) — Live browser compiler and preview workbench
- [Changelog](https://sola-air.dev/changelog) — Release history and runtime updates
